```{=html}
<div class="slack-section">
  <h2 class="slack-h2">A community built for users</h2>
  <p class="slack-prose">Whether you run a planetarium dome, teach with OpenSpace, contribute code, or are just getting started &mdash; Slack is the fastest way to get answers, share your work, and connect with the people who know OpenSpace best.</p>
  <p class="slack-prose">Ask questions, report issues, share screenshots of your work, stay current on new releases, and get direct support from the core team and experienced community members worldwide.</p>
</div>

<div class="slack-channels-section">
  <h2 class="slack-h2">Find your channel</h2>
  <p class="slack-channels-lede">The workspace is organized into focused channels. Here are some of the best places to start.</p>
  <div class="slack-channels-grid">

    <div class="slack-channel-group">
      <p class="slack-channel-group-label">Get started</p>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#intros</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Introduce yourself to the community</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#openspace-help</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Ask questions and get answers</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#announcements</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Software updates and community events</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#hub</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Assets and content shared on the OpenSpace Hub</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="slack-channel-group">
      <p class="slack-channel-group-label">Technical</p>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#bugs-and-breaks</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Report issues you've encountered</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#compiling</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Build and compilation support</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#breaking-changes</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Stay current on software changes</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#documentation</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Contribute to OpenSpace documentation</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="slack-channel-group">
      <p class="slack-channel-group-label">Share & inspire</p>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#showcase</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Show off your OpenSpace work</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#video-making</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Rendering and producing videos with OpenSpace</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#wishlist</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Feature requests and ideas</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#events</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Programs, conferences, and community gatherings</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="slack-channel-group">
      <p class="slack-channel-group-label">Your community</p>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#users-at-planetariums</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Connect with planetarium professionals</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#users-at-museums-and-science-centers</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Museum and science center network</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#users-at-higher-education-institutions</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">University and research communities</span>
      </div>
      <div class="slack-channel-item">
        <span class="slack-channel-name">#random</span>
        <span class="slack-channel-desc">Interesting news and off-topic conversation</span>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
```
